source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.
offlane.issue: names Steel as beating you, but the checkpoint verdict for Steel is even
offlane.rewrite: Zarus wins this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

midlane.quote: Abyssal Rift's channel drops you into their team — save it for a fight already won, not as an escape from Gideon.
midlane.issue: misdescribes the ultimate — Abyssal Rift teleports Renna to a location she picks, it does not inherently drop her into the enemy team, and the real caution is the 1.5s channel
midlane.rewrite: Abyssal Rift takes a 1.5s channel before it teleports you, so start it before you are in trouble and pick the landing spot — it will not save you once Gideon is already on you.

offlane.quote: Open with Bull Rush to knock them back into your minions, follow with Shield Bash for the stun, and put Force Shield in their escape path for the slow. Oathkeeper at minute 19 adds damage to that chain.
offlane.issue: Bull Rush knocks enemies back away from Steel as he charges, so it pushes them further from your own minions, not into them
offlane.rewrite: Open with Bull Rush to close and knock them back, follow with Shield Bash for the stun, and put Force Shield in their escape path for the slow. Oathkeeper at minute 19 adds damage to that chain.

midlane.quote: Poke with RMB Knock, Knock! from long range and clear minions with it, then commit only after Q Peekaboo! lands — the marked shot is your damage. Viper and Deathstalker by minute 18 make that pair actually kill.
midlane.issue: "the marked shot is your damage" is a damage-share claim the source cannot support, and it contradicts the stage timeline's "best at sustained basic-attack damage"
midlane.rewrite: Poke with RMB Knock, Knock! from long range and clear minions with it, then commit only after Q Peekaboo! lands — the mark makes that shot hit far harder. Viper and Deathstalker by minute 18 make that pair actually kill.
